sentences: Did you know the *first Woody* almost killed *Toy Story*?
Back in *1993*, Pixar showed Disney an early version of the movie.
And Woody? He was a total *jerk*. Like, mean, selfish, yelling at all his friends.
But Disney *hated* it, so they literally *shut* the whole movie down.
So Pixar went back, rewrote everything, and that's how we got the *Woody* we love today.
